title: An attacker might be able to forge its own source IP, smuggle DNS records or bypass EDNS options filtering via a…
description: This vulnerability involves the potential for an attacker to forge source IP addresses, smuggle DNS records, or bypass EDNS options filtering through specially crafted DNS queries when EDNS Client Subnet is enabled between DNSdist and its backend. The issue affects DNSdist configurations with EDNS Client Subnet enabled and could lead to limited confidentiality and integrity impacts.
